Description

Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

Support cargo operations and office administration requirements in Frankfurt.

- Answer enquiries from customers regarding cargo handling/packaging requirements and special services
- Handle irregularities and operational disruptions
- Maintain and arrange replenishment of the office’s forms, labels and stationery inventories.
- Monitor the ULD build-up of high value / hi-tech product shipments to prevent incidents of pilferage while goods are within the cargo terminal facility

- Good airfreight industry knowledge
- Two years related work experience

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Bilingual (English and German)

About Allianz Global Investors
Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.
We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  
We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  
Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  
We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 
If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. 

To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.

To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.

The Business Process Engineer for Third-Party Risk Management is responsible for designing, optimizing, and continuously improving the end-to-end processes that support the identification, assessment, monitoring, and management of third-party (vendor, supplier, outsourcing) risk across the organization.
The role bridges risk management requirements with operational execution, translating regulatory and policy requirements (e.g., DORA, outsourcing guidelines) into efficient, scalable, and auditable workflows.
This role will be based in Frankfurt.

What you will do

- Process Design & Optimization: Map, analyse, and redesign TPRM lifecycle processes (onboarding, due diligence, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, offboarding) to improve efficiency, consistency, and control effectiveness
- Workflow & Tooling: design and implement defined TPRM workflow in the Sourcing & Procurement ServiceNow Platform. Configure, enhance, and maintain workflow tools (e.g. ServiceNow, Databricks) that support process execution and data capture
- Align and harmonize the Procurement and TPRM workflows as an integrated workflow
- Requirements Translation: Work with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Procurement to translate regulatory obligations (such as DORA ICT third-party risk requirements) and internal policy into operational process steps and control points as part of the workflow
- Documentation & Governance: Create and maintain process maps, standard operating procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices, and control documentation; ensure processes are inventoried and governed per internal EUC/process governance standards
- Reporting: Define and track process KPIs/KRIs (e.g., cycle times, SLA adherence, backlog, exception rates) to support management reporting and continuous improvement
- Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a liaison between TPRM, business units, IT, Procurement, and second-line risk functions to ensure process changes are understood, adopted, and sustainable
- Change Management: Lead process changes initiatives, including impact assessment, testing, training, and rollout of new or revised procedures
- AI and Continuous Improvement: Identify automation opportunities (e.g., Multi AI Agent orchestration, workflow automation, questionnaire logic, risk scoring rules) and work with relevant teams to implement them, subject to governance and review requirements
- Quality & Control: Support internal audit, regulatory exam, and quality assurance activities by ensuring processes are well-documented, consistently applied, and evidenced
- RUN & Governance Responsibility: Ensure the Oversight and RUN activities for the Third-Party Risk Management team

What you bring

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
- 6+ years of experience in business process engineering, process improvement, or operations roles, ideally within financial services or asset management
- Prior exposure to Third-Party Risk Management, vendor management, outsourcing oversight, or operational risk is highly desirable
- Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN) and process mapping tools
- Understanding of relevant regulatory frameworks (e.g., DORA, EBA/ESMA outsourcing guidelines) is a plus
- Experience with GRC or TPRM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Archer, OneTrust, or similar) or Databricks preferred
- Being a team player
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Proactive and client-centric approach, combining diplomacy and assertiveness
- Proficiency in English required, further languages would be highly helpful, German is a plus
- AI Skills such as Microsoft Copilot, Feature Engineering, Data Engineering

What we offer

- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans
- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
- Company share purchasing plan
- Mental health and wellbeing programs
- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
- Self-guided learning & development
- … and so much more!

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

Your Role:

At the intersection of science, strategy, and commercial impact, this role places you at the heart of some of the most consequential decisions in healthcare drug development and commercialization. As an Associate Director within the Global Strategic Insights function, you will serve as a trusted thought partner to therapy area commercial teams — translating complex market dynamics into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes how healthcare assets are launched, grown, and managed across major global markets.

This role will interact primarily with the Rare Tumor and Specialty Therapy Area teams, partnering closely with colleagues who are driving some of the most strategically significant assets in the portfolio.

You will own the end-to-end delivery of insights across one or more GSI disciplines (primary market research, competitive intelligence, or strategic forecasting), ensuring every recommendation is grounded in rigorous analysis and directly informs critical business decisions.

Working with cross-functional partners across commercial strategy, market access and pricing, other GSI functions, and regional insights teams, you will drive insights that elevate decision quality at critical stages of the asset lifecycle.

Who You Are :

- A degree in life sciences, business, economics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience — is required.
- 5 or more years of experience in at least one global strategic insights discipline — primary market research, competitive intelligence, data analytics, or strategic forecasting — ideally within the pharmaceutical or biopharma industry.
- You have designed and led insights and KPI workstreams for in-market or launch assets, with at least 2 years of direct experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.
- You hold deep expertise in one or more of the following: qualitative and quantitative primary market research (study design, discussion guide development, strategic recommendations); global competitive intelligence (trial monitoring, congress coverage, strategic simulation); or topline forecasting (model building, opportunity assessment, scenario analysis).
- You have global experience across two or more major markets — such as the US, China, EU4 and UK, or Japan — and bring a nuanced understanding of how market dynamics differ across regions.
- You work effectively across functions, with a solid understanding of how commercial strategy, market access and pricing, and regional insights teams each contribute to asset success.
- You are comfortable navigating the full medicine lifecycle — from proof-of-concept through in-market management — and understand how insights activities evolve at each stage.
- You communicate complex findings with clarity and confidence, translating analytical outputs into compelling narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders and drive informed decisions.
- English fluent, additional languages are a plus

We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. At the intersection of scientific innovation and patient impact, this role places you at the heart of next-generation biotherapeutic development. As the NBE DMPK Lead, you will serve as the authoritative scientific expert for drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics across a portfolio of novel biological entities — including ADCs, AOCs, and multispecific biologics. You will define the DMPK strategy for each molecule, integrating PK, immunogenicity, and bioanalytical approaches to de-risk clinical development and drive health authority submissions. Applying Modeling and Simulation, you will generate data-driven insights to inform molecular design and translate preclinical findings into human dose predictions. Embedded in cross-functional project teams, you will guide peers and senior stakeholders — shaping the scientific direction of your projects.

This position is limited for two years.

Who You Are:

- You hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Pharmacokinetics, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnological Sciences, Biomedical or Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related biological or chemical discipline; a doctoral degree with relevant industry experience is typical for this level.
- You bring substantial professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with deep expertise in PK/PD concepts across drug discovery and development — including translational sciences and regulatory requirements for biotherapeutics such as ADCs, AOCs, and multispecific biologics.
- You have hands-on experience with quantitative modeling approaches, including M&S tools, population PK software, QSP platforms, or programming environments such as Python or R; experience with AI/ML applications in drug development is a strong advantage.
- You possess a solid understanding of adjacent disciplines — including pharmacology, toxicology, nonclinical safety, drug design, and bioanalytics — and can integrate insights across these areas to guide biotherapeutic engineering and optimization.
- You communicate complex scientific concepts clearly and confidently to diverse audiences, including cross-functional project teams and senior stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing decisions without direct authority.
- You are fluent in written and spoken English; proficiency in German or Italian is an advantage.
- You bring strong organizational skills, intercultural awareness, and the ability to manage multiple project commitments with a high degree of autonomy.

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Procurement Contracts Manager (m/f) to join our "Procurement Contracts department" dedicated to the Space Systems Business line. The successful candidate will be based in Bremen, Germany.

- Develop new and further development of existing Procurement Academy training; coaching and training-on-the-job of our stakeholders in the areas of contracts management and negotiations,

In order to support Airframe Engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Fatigue & Damage Tolerance Engineer (d/f/m)

Become part of a pioneering team with a strong identity and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class stress solutions!

​Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) Engineer for Primary Structure, you will will have the chance of contributing to the structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will grow into a technical expert, collaborating with a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a motivated, curious engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace excellence.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Structural Analysis: Analyze and Validate composite & hybrid structures for Fatigue and Damage Tolerance according to validated methods.
- Airworthiness & Maintenance Criteria: Ensure adherence to relevant regulations, relevant design principles, processes, methods and manufacturing capabilities guidelines.
- Structural Testing: Participate in the planning and analysis of fatigue tests, helping to validate theoretical models with real-world data
- Cross-Functional Certification: Collaborate with Design, Materials, and Stress teams to learn how F&DT requirements are integrated into the earliest design phases
- Support Fleet In-Service Solutions: Provide stress analysis for the repair/acceptance of damaged structures
- Manage Technical Project Deliverables: Define technical scopes, workload sizing, and lead times, ensuring high-quality inputs and the mitigation of technical risks/opportunities
- Continuous Innovation & Method Improvement: Contribute to the evolution of internal analysis tools and structural health monitoring strategies.

​In essence, you will support the delivery of technical outputs in Time, Cost, and Quality, guided by senior experts and technical leadears.

- You hold a Master's degree / Diploma in Engineering or similar qualifications
- You bring first experience in Fatigue & Damage Tolerance and associated Process, Methods & Tools
- You enjoy working with many interfaces with different knowledge levels and cultural backgrounds adapting your communication accordingly
- You have a creative data-driven mindset and are motivated to improve the way we work and interact with the world around us (e.g. using AI)

- Coordinate the development and implementation of test methodologies for GaN devices, including both wafer-level and product-level testing
- Lead test and characterization concepts and implementation initiatives, and propose new test and characterization setups to solve issues, considering all product aspects from design-to-manufacturing to effective cost structure
- Collaborate closely with device, product, and application engineers to develop test solutions that benefit product development, quality, and customer requirements
